name: Granite Balanceknob
description: Open in a guard that offers two courts, the baton before the heart and the free hand before the face.

name: Vengeful Crackdown
description: Thrust the baton's tip at the sternum while the free palm pushes at the shoulder, so the opponent is turned.

name: Gust Lanyardloop
description: Enter the opponent's court with a measured step onto their centreline, the baton level at the hip.

name: Gyve Stun
description: Hook the baton under the opponent's wrist and carry it from one court of the body to the other.

name: Batondurance
description: Knock the guarding hand away with a short qi-edged rap, opening the line the court protects.

name: Shade Sidebar
description: Press the baton along the opponent's upper arm and hold them in place with the weight of both hands.

name: Doctrine Shortstick
description: Rap the shoulder and the hip in two beats, the second a hand's breadth after the first.

name: Intentbilly
description: Strike the radial nerve along the forearm with a pulse of qi, sealing the hand's strength for a short while.

name: Nova Rapidrap
description: After a held breath gathers qi in the baton, bring it down through the guard so the blow lands on two lines.

name: Flintlike Batongrip
description: Wait in a still guard with the baton low, as a hawk waits above a basin.

name: Phantom Gripwrap
description: Fold the arms in and step close to the opponent's flank like a hawk drawing its wings in.

name: Granite Weightend
description: Rap the outer rim of the opponent's forearm and glide away along its curve.

name: Murk Hardwood
description: Cast the baton across the line of attack like a passing shadow and push the blow off.

name: Might Truncheon
description: Jab down a steep line into the upper chest, the baton dropping like a diving hawk.

name: Chimeswitch
description: Sweep the baton along the floor of the stance and trip the lead ankle with a qi pulse.

name: Capend Durance
description: Hook the baton's end into the crook of the elbow like a talon and pull the arm off its line.

name: Enthralling Tick
description: Press the baton against the shoulder and keep the pressure level like water in a basin, until the opponent sinks.

name: Grievous Cuff
description: Sweep the baton wide with the arms spread, driving several attackers back from the guard line.

name: Cuff Durance
description: Strike the nerve above the elbow in one keen rap that holds the arm's qi shut.

name: Glint Capend
description: Cross the gap in a single flash, the baton landing as a hawk strikes the water, and the opponent never sees the step.

name: Charter Gripwrap
description: Hold the baton with the qi field spread over both tracks of the body at once.

name: Switchvortex
description: Advance down two lanes in turn, first the guard lane and then the strike lane.

name: Blazestun
description: Rap along the track of the field so that the blow lands a little before the baton does.

name: Batongrip Durance
description: Parry on one track and turn the body onto the other, ready to strike from the new line.

name: Overpowering Switch
description: Hook the baton under the arm while the field catches the wrist, so the limb is caught twice.

name: Chime Balanceknob
description: Switch tracks as the opponent commits and jolt the baton across their wrist, breaking the follow-through.

name: Batonnerve
description: Press the shoulder along both lines at once, the baton above and the field below.

name: Gyvecapend
description: Close the field round the opponent's wrist from a pace away and hold it clamped.

name: Tempered Truncheon
description: Send the baton through one track and the field through the other so that the blow breaks the guard.

name: Unbowed Shortstick
description: Draw the opponent's blow along one track of the field and send it back along the other.

name: Billyvalor
description: Stand with the baton in one hand and the palm of the other open, both covering the centreline.

name: Headlong Lanyardloop
description: Slip forward on the open-hand side while the baton hangs back, ready to follow.

name: Might Stun
description: Rap with the baton and slap with the palm in the same beat on opposite arms.

name: Invincible Hardwood
description: Turn a straight blow with the open palm while the baton covers the other side.

name: Murk Lanyardloop
description: Raise the baton in a steep rising block that sends an overhead strike to the side.

name: Ponderous Sidebar
description: Catch the wrist in the open hand and lay the baton across it, so the two hold as one.

name: Immobilizing Crackdown
description: Pinch the opponent's arm between palm and rod and press steadily with qi down to the bone.

name: Chimebilly
description: Shove the butt of the baton with the open palm, adding the whole arm's weight to a short drive.

name: Webbing Sidebar
description: Pull with the palm and hook with the baton in opposite directions, throwing the opponent across the hip.

name: Deedcuff
description: Seal the arm by striking the nerve with the baton while the palm presses the matching point on the other side.

name: Merciless Hardwood
description: Sweep the baton and palm together through the guard so that both land inside the cover.

name: Escalating Switch
description: Run through six blows alternating baton and palm, each landing a little deeper than the last.

name: Brutalizing Crackdown
description: Land the baton and the open palm on one spot in the same instant, doubling the blow's force into the body.

name: Unconquered Truncheon
description: Hold the baton along an even line from shoulder to hip, calm as a river in its bed.

name: Torrent Switch
description: Slide into range in a smooth line without a visible lift of the heel.

name: Punishing Weightend
description: Rap the arm with a flowing motion that carries on past the point of contact.

name: Capendmettle
description: Set the baton firm as a river bank and let the opponent's blow run along it.

name: Blaze Rapidrap
description: Tap the opponent's forearm, wrist and knuckles in a skipping line of three light blows.

name: Thorn Tick
description: Hook the baton round the arm and drag it downstream, the opponent pulled along in its flow.

name: Rumble Capend
description: Spin the baton in a small eddy under the wrist and flip the hand out of its guard.

name: Intent Rapidrap
description: Press the baton onto the thigh and drag downward, pulling the opponent's stance under them.

name: Mayhem Batongrip
description: Cross the opponent's feet with the baton as in crossing a ford, tipping them off their stride.

name: Boring Weightend
description: Drive the baton with a swelling push of qi, breaking through the guard like a flood through a bank.

name: Maiming Gripwrap
description: Run the baton down the arm in one slow pass, sealing the qi channels along its whole length.

name: Lot Stun
description: Run a flood of raps, hooks and shoves down the opponent's side, each pushing them farther along the line.

name: Ironbaton
description: Perch in a high, narrow guard with the baton on the shoulder and the eyes on the opponent's hips.

name: Gust Rapidrap
description: Walk with the slow, lifted steps of a hawk on the ground, never putting the full weight down.

name: Gust Truncheon
description: Peck the baton's tip against the opponent's knuckle in one quick short blow.

name: Cuff Mettle
description: Hook the baton over the opponent's wrist as if to a perch and draw the arm down.

name: Toxin Lanyardloop
description: Check a swinging arm at the elbow with a short jolt that folds it like a wing.

name: Enthralling Balanceknob
description: Hold the opponent's forearm down on a table or wall with the baton and a slow, steady qi pressure.

name: Hellish Stun
description: Stoop from the perch and drive the baton through the guard, qi reaching the muscle behind it.

name: Strangling Gripwrap
description: Rap the nerve at the wrist from above in a falling beat that seals the hand's qi.

name: Capendrespite
description: Read the opponent's breath through the baton's field while hovering, then fall on the opening with one full strike.

name: Impenetrable Sidebar
description: Wait with the baton held at the hip into the wind, having sworn to strike only if struck.

name: Gustswitch
description: Step out to the full reach of the baton and stay there, never crowding inside.

name: Eviscerating Shortstick
description: Rap the arm with a sudden gust of the whole stance behind the baton.

name: Chimecapend
description: Cut across the blow like a wind across a ridge and send it spinning wide.

name: Gyvecuff
description: Hook the baton behind the arm and draw it onto the bearing in one long pull.

name: Strangling Shortstick
description: Jolt the wrist with a sworn, measured tap of qi, enough to open the hand and no more.

name: Suffocating Weightend
description: Lean the whole body into the baton like a gale on a tree and press the opponent down.

name: Switch Nerve
description: Strike at the end of the baton's full reach, sealing the nerve at the elbow before the opponent can close.

name: Lot Crackdown
description: Chain four raps on one bearing, arm, ribs, thigh and shin, each carried by the wind of the one before.

name: Berserk Tempered Balanceknob
description: After gathering qi along the bearing, bring the baton down like a gale from the plateau, through any guard.

name: Granite Batongrip
description: Hold the baton across the thighs with both hands, a quiet posture that shows the oath of restraint.

name: Silttick
description: Shuffle in the broad stance of the plateau, feet wide and the weight low.

name: Sanguine Hardwood
description: Rap the hand that holds a weapon so that the weapon falls, then step back.

name: Hardwood Fortitude
description: Catch a blow at the edge of the stance with the baton's middle and turn it away.

name: Unsparing Capend
description: Jab the baton in a sudden gust at the soft belly, withdrawing before the opponent doubles over.

name: Gyve Tick
description: Drag the baton down the opponent's forearm and over the wrist, taking the hand with it.

name: Toxinswitch
description: Shove the baton's middle into the chest with a jolt that drives the opponent one pace back.

name: Webbing Balanceknob
description: Press the baton across the shoulder blades and hold the opponent face down until they yield.

name: Suffocating Rapidrap
description: Sweep the baton at the ankle in a gust and let the opponent's own step finish the trip.

name: Maiming Cuff
description: Strike the nerve above the wrist by the old lineage's pattern, sealing the hand's qi.

name: Hour Capend
description: Run three strikes that each give the opponent the chance to yield before the next lands.

name: Intent Weightend
description: Keep an arm sealed and bound through one long exhale, holding the opponent still without a second blow.

name: Aegiscapend
description: Hold the baton out toward a fixed mark to take a bearing, then draw it in without losing the line.

name: Silt Batongrip
description: Stride long and low along the bearing, the baton trailing like a streamer in the gale.

name: Sanguine Gripwrap
description: Rap the arm that lies on the bearing and take the baton back along the same line.

name: Ponderous Cuff
description: Hook the baton behind the leading arm and draw it onto the bearing.

name: Mayhem Shortstick
description: Cross the opponent's line with a short jolt of the baton that breaks their advance.

name: Intentcapend
description: Lean the baton's weight onto the arm and pin it, bearing on it like a steady gale.

name: Truncheon Reckoning
description: Drive the baton along the bearing straight through the guard into the ribs.

name: Switch Valor
description: Hold the baton on the bearing against the elbow, sealing its qi for as long as the line is kept.

name: Ghosting Tick
description: Flash along the bearing in one step and bind the opponent's arm before they can turn.

name: Iron Lanyardloop
description: Stand in open ground with the baton level and the guard turned to every side at once.

name: Ghosting Cuff
description: Circle the opponent in a wide ring, never stepping into a place that has no way out.

name: Batonwrath
description: Rap the arm in a calm hush, the baton barely seeming to move before it lands.

name: Billydurance
description: Reach out with the baton to catch a blow early, well before it nears the body.

name: Capendhavoc
description: Cut a wide level arc through the side of the opponent's guard in open ground.

name: Thorn Lanyardloop
description: Hook the baton round the opponent's arm as they pass through the ring and turn them with it.

name: Chimecuff
description: Jolt the baton against the elbow in a short draft of qi, breaking the swing.

name: Stunspine
description: Press down on the opponent's shoulders with the baton and the whole sky of qi above, forcing them to kneel.

name: Lottick
description: Reach through the field to strike the elbow nerve, sealing the limb's qi from a full stride away.

name: Escalating Tick
description: Break through a ring of attackers with a chain of strikes, each opening the way for the next.

name: Unbowed Facet Truncheon
description: Let a rush slide along the field and turn its force back with a half-turn of the baton, needing no wall.

name: Aegis Sidebar
description: Hold the baton upright against the breastbone and speak the first oath, to restrain before striking.

name: Gustcuff
description: Take the second oath's step: forward on the weaker side, never on the opponent's strong line.

name: Blaze Switch
description: Rap once at the wrist, the third oath's pledge that one blow will do.

name: Torrent Shortstick
description: Block with the baton's middle, protecting the body and giving the opponent no wound to answer.

name: Mightbaton
description: Jab the baton at the thigh, the fifth oath's limit of force against a standing foe.

name: Numbing Gripwrap
description: Hook the baton behind the elbow and drag the arm out, bearing the opponent off their line.

name: Mayhem Rapidrap
description: Jolt the baton's end into the wrist hollow to loosen a weapon hand.

name: Charter Crackdown
description: Lean slowly on the baton across the shoulder and keep pressing until the opponent kneels.

name: Mayhemcuff
description: Sweep the baton along the ground to the ankle and take the opponent's feet out.

name: Overpowering Sidebar
description: Rap the elbow nerve and seal the qi in the arm with a single sworn blow.

name: Drilltick
description: Break through a raised guard with a qi-driven thrust, then hold the baton still to show the oath unbroken.

name: Hardwood Wrath
description: Chain a rap, a hook and a press, three oaths in one smooth run.

name: Strangling Charter Capend
description: Hold the whole body of the opponent bound still within the baton's field until they yield.

name: Balanceknob Obduracy
description: Hold the baton on one fixed line from hip to eye and keep it there whatever follows.

name: Cuffflash
description: Drift along the bearing in small steps, the baton never leaving its line.

name: Gust Crackdown
description: Rap the arm along the held line and return to the line at once.

name: Unrelenting Weightend
description: Parry by turning the wrist only, so the baton stays on the line it started.

name: Thornswitch
description: Hook the arm and draw it onto the baton's line, where it can be held.

name: Chime Batongrip
description: Drift in and jolt the baton against the wrist, breaking the opponent's rhythm.

name: Ponderous Stun
description: Press the baton onto the held line of the arm and bear down with level qi.

name: Mastering Hardwood
description: Seal the nerve on the baton's line with one rap that never leaves the bearing.

name: Iron Tick
description: Strike along the held line with qi behind the shaft, breaking through whatever stands on it.

name: Impervious Capend
description: Hold the baton unmoving on its line against a heavy blow, the qi field bracing the whole body behind it.
